full_mpc_state_gaps: No valid live horizontal position/velocity or heading_good_for_control on the present bench
No accepted real TS20 q/dq feedback and actual command/packet history
Stock audited ODOMETRY lacks EKF world acceleration; HIGHRES_IMU has a different physical/filtering meaning
ESTIMATOR_STATUS and aggregate odometry reset counter do not preserve every original local-position validity/reset field
notes: These rates are project requests and bandwidth upper bounds, not official maximum rates or measured delivery guarantees.
MPC future budget is a capacity reservation, not approval to send real position setpoints.
No signing is currently configured; signed-size calculation only reserves space and is not a signing/security claim.
All persistent NX configuration changes/deployment need user approval. UART termios is per-session and restored. No USB protocol switching.
